rows: Scribe or extra time

A scribe, compensatory time or both. For a three-hour paper the extra time is 60 minutes, and it is 50 minutes for 2.5 hours, 40 for two hours and 30 for 1.5 hours. The scribe should not hold qualifications in the subject, and the candidate may choose the scribe.
Ask the school to record the facility at registration.
Fewer languages
Candidates with 2016 Act disabilities may study one compulsory language instead of two, within the three-language formula, and then choose four other subjects.
Check how this affects college eligibility before you choose.
Physical education
Physiotherapy exercises are treated as equivalent to the Board's Physical and Health Education course.
Ask the school to record your physiotherapy.
Third language (Classes VI to VIII)
Exemption is available to candidates with disabilities defined in the 2016 Act.
Apply through the school.
How to apply
Apply through the school head to the Regional Office with a medical certificate, preferably in Class IX or XI. Only students recorded in those classes are considered.
Do not wait for Class X or XII.
Higher education seats
The Act reserves 5 percent of seats in government and government-aided higher-education institutions for students with benchmark disabilities.
Check the admission notice for how the quota is split and what certificate is needed.
Government jobs

A DoPT order of 15 January 2018 reserves 4 percent of direct-recruitment vacancies, with 1 percent for locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims and muscular dystrophy. It applies only to posts identified as suitable.
Read the identified-post list in each notice.
MBBS and medical courses

In Omkar Ramchandra Gond v. Union of India (15 October 2024) the Supreme Court held that the mere existence of a benchmark disability will not disqualify a candidate, and that assessment boards must record whether the disability prevents the course. The NMC's 2026 guidelines describe a competency-based assessment with separate affidavit formats for upper-limb and lower-limb locomotor disability.
Read the current NMC guidelines and the counselling instructions.
